title: Someone smart talk me out of dollar cost averaging SVXY for the next couple weeks..
summary: I'm sure the VIX will probably go higher than it is but I'm not interested in trying to catch a (rising knife). For reference this is not a short term play I'm interested in DCA'ing it and then holding for at least a year- maybe forever:) I can't pinpoint calculate the ROI on SVXY vs. SPY because of the multiple forward and reverse splits SVXY has undergone.But my amateur calculations aggregating the multiple forward and reverse splits into a single 2 for 1 split has the ROI at 266 % versus SPY at 85 percent for the last 5 years. So assuming a margin of error of 300 percent on my math it's still a winner.submitted by/u/ScholarPrize1335[link][comments]

title: Anyone else catching the falling knife in SaaS lately?
summary: AI fears have crushed software stocks while the rest of tech is near highs.Valuations looks attractive though, with many names at multi-year lows despite wide moats and strong margins.
